title: Normalize Heterogeneous Robot Observation Schemas
summary: Robot datasets often describe the same signal under different keys and units.

frames: Declared normalized action/feature coordinates; no implicit frame conversion

units.values: Caller supplies multiplicative conversion factors such as centimeters to meters0.01 or degrees to radianspi/180; output units are the declared canonical units.

physical_contract.axes: raw fields(T,Df), timestamps(T) -> canonical feature dict(T,Df) and timestamps(T)
physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: One synchronized strictly increasing timestamp vector applies to every field; this function cannot align unsynchronized records.
physical_contract.batching: raw fields(T,Df), timestamps(T) -> canonical feature dict(T,Df) and timestamps(T)

provenance.authoring_notes: Original shared-schema adapter motivated by Open X-Embodiment dataset standardization. Field mapping and scaling are explicit educational policy, not the complete OXE dataset transforms.
